title: Google Cloud India AI Hub Announced in Visakhapatnam ($15 Billion Investment)
summary: Google commits $15B over 5 years for a 1 GW AI & Data Centre Hub in Visakhapatnam across 600 acres with AdaniConneX and Airtel.

blocks.title: 📰 5. 🤝 MoUs, CONFERENCES & APPOINTMENTS
blocks.text: 🪝 Google Cloud India AI Hub Announced in Visakhapatnam ($15 Billion Investment). Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw and AP CM N. Chandrababu Naidu laid the foundation stone for the **'Google Cloud India AI Hub'** at Visakhapatnam.
**Scale**: $15 billion investment over 5 years (2026-2030), India's single largest FDI (foreign direct investment with management stake) since independence. Initial capacity: 1 GW across 600 acres.
**Infrastructure**: AdaniConneX handles data center/power; Airtel builds fiber networks and 3 subsea cable landing stations.
